hints.title: Global Array Span Monotonicity
hints.text: Notice that the difference between the maximum and minimum element cannot exceed the global span across the entire array.

hints.title: Full Array Inclusion
hints.text: Because the entire array has length n >= k, the entire array is a valid candidate subarray.

hints.title: Linear Extrema Pass
hints.text: Find the maximum and minimum elements in a single pass and return their difference.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass minimum and maximum reduction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all subarrays takes quadratic time O(N^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Realize that expanding the window to full length yields the maximal possible difference.
